lines.text: Up 276% on the year: Weavile G (Platinum) 17/127 went from $4.94 on Oct 30, 2025 to $18.59 on Oct 27, and is up 4% over 7 days and up 33% over 30 days. That beats its set over 30 days: up 33% against a +5.9% median for 46 Platinum items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9937 priced items across the market. It is level with its highest price on file, first reached on Oct 24, with records back to Feb 8, 2024.
Celestial Storm, about 30 days: 11 of 35 priced cards up 10% or more, 2 down 10% or more. Start prices Sep 26 to Sep 27, end Oct 27, TCGplayer market.
